title: Feature Engineering
objectives: Explain the key ideas behind Feature Engineering.
Describe why Feature Engineering matters in Data Science.
Apply Feature Engineering to a realistic scenario.
Identify common pitfalls and how to avoid them.
Answer interview questions about Feature Engineering.
definition: Feature Engineering is a core concept in Data Science. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What Feature Engineering is
theory.body: Feature Engineering describes the methods and patterns used within Data Science to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Feature Engineering is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why Feature Engineering matters
theory.body: Without Feature Engineering, systems built with Data Science are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Feature Engineering works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Feature Engineering follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Feature Engineering.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Feature Engineering
theory.body: Feature Engineering offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
